macros.name: academicyear
macros.doc: Use this macro to specify the academicyear in full, i.e. in the form XXXX-YYYY.

macros.name: copyrightnotices
macros.doc: Use this macro to specify additional copyright notice messages to appear in het copyright notice on the bottom of page 2 of your course text.

macros.name: courseversion
macros.doc: This macro indicates which version of the course this is.

macros.name: department
macros.doc: This macro sets the department name.

macros.name: departmentacronym
macros.doc: This macro sets the acronym of the department.

macros.name: maketitle
macros.doc: The title page is generated using the \maketitle command.

macros.name: professor
macros.doc: This is the name of the person that actually teaches the course (in Dutch: titularis).

macros.name: programme
macros.doc: Code of the subject you are teaching.

macros.name: subtitle
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@subtitle tag that later will be used on the title page, in the header/footer and to set the appropriate hyperref tag.

macros.name: titlepagepicture
macros.doc: Specify the filename of a picture you want to appear on your titlepage.

macros.name: versioncomment
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@versioncomment tag that later will be used on the title page and in the copyright message.

macros.name: versionyear
macros.doc: This is to be the year in which you published the current version of the course in the form YYYY.
